rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS so_luong FROM khoa_hoc WHERE danh_muc ILIKE 'Tiếng Anh' LIMIT 200
SELECT AVG(hoc_phi) AS avg_hoc_phi FROM khoa_hoc WHERE danh_muc ILIKE '%Lập trình%' LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(so_tien), 0) AS total_revenue FROM thanh_toan WHERE ngay_thanh_toan >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND ngay_thanh_toan < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) AS so_lop_online FROM lop_hoc WHERE hinh_thuc ILIKE 'online' LIMIT 200

SELECT SUM(d.thanh_tien - COALESCE(p.tong_thanh_toan, 0)) AS tong_no FROM don_hang AS d LEFT JOIN (SELECT don_hang_id, SUM(so_tien) AS tong_thanh_toan FROM thanh_toan GROUP BY don_hang_id) AS p ON d.id = p.don_hang_id WHERE d.trang_thai IN ('chua_thanh_toan', 'thanh_toan_mot_phan') LIMIT 200
SELECT l.ca_hoc, COUNT(*) AS so_luot_dang_ky FROM don_hang AS d JOIN lop_hoc AS l ON d.lop_hoc_id = l.id WHERE d.trang_thai <> 'da_huy' GROUP BY l.ca_hoc ORDER BY so_luot_dang_ky DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) AS so_hoc_vien FROM hoc_vien WHERE thanh_pho ILIKE '%hà nội%' LIMIT 200

SELECT kh.danh_muc, SUM(tt.so_tien) AS doanh_thu_thuc_thu FROM thanh_toan AS tt JOIN don_hang AS dh ON tt.don_hang_id = dh.id JOIN lop_hoc AS lh ON dh.lop_hoc_id = lh.id JOIN khoa_hoc AS kh ON lh.khoa_hoc_id = kh.id WHERE tt.ngay_thanh_toan >= CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE) AS DATE) AND tt.ngay_thanh_toan <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY kh.danh_muc ORDER BY kh.danh_muc LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tt.don_hang_id) AS so_luong_hoan_tien FROM thanh_toan AS tt WHERE tt.so_tien < 0 LIMIT 200
SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE LOWER(nguon) = 'facebook') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS pct_facebook FROM hoc_vien LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) AS so_hoc_vien_moi FROM hoc_vien WHERE ngay_dang_ky >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 DAYS' AND ngay_dang_ky <= CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 200
SELECT SUM(giam_gia) AS total_giam_gia FROM don_hang WHERE trang_thai <> 'da_huy' LIMIT 200

SELECT kh.trinh_do, COUNT(*) AS so_luong FROM don_hang AS dh JOIN lop_hoc AS lh ON dh.lop_hoc_id = lh.id JOIN khoa_hoc AS kh ON lh.khoa_hoc_id = kh.id WHERE dh.trang_thai <> 'da_huy' GROUP BY kh.trinh_do ORDER BY kh.trinh_do LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) AS so_lan FROM thanh_toan WHERE phuong_thuc = 'tien_mat' LIMIT 200
SELECT ten, hoc_phi FROM khoa_hoc ORDER BY hoc_phi DESC LIMIT 1
